description: The places and people of a business (C200), the administration side: what its bookings use. kind "sites" (a place: { name, timeZone?, address?, hours? }), "resources" (a group of identical units: { name, site?, count (how many: 30 tables, 200 spaces; 1), capacity (how many fit in one; 1), hours? }) and "staff" (the professionals: { name, email?, sites? ([ids] where they work), hours? }). hours: { timeZone?, week: { MO: ["09:00-14:00", "16:00-20:00"], … } (a day left out is closed; a professional's range can say where: { from, to, site }), closed?: ["2026-12-25"] }; none: always open. action "list" { kind }, "save" { kind, id?, …fields } (makes one, or changes the one with that id: only the fields given), "remove" { kind, id } (refused with in_use while a session to come or a service uses it). "accounts" { from?, to? } (this month by default): per professional, site and resource, the sessions, minutes and people, to pay them outside Neblla; and the notes written by hand with their total per who. "agenda" { from, to } (at most 62 days): every service's sessions in that time, each with its set, who booked, its places and its state (confirmed, proposed, cancelled), as a calendar shows them. "note" { who ("staff:<id>", "site:<id>" or a name), amount (cents: what the business owes them, negative when it paid), date?, note? }, "notes" { from?, to?, who? }, "removeNote" { id }. A client's card: "userBookings" { user } (the user id in the app: their bookings of every service, upcoming and past), "userNotes" { user } (the business's private notes about them, never shown to them), "userNote" { user, text }, "removeUserNote" { id }. Sessions are made with neblla_booking createSlot (site, staff, resource); a service names the resources and staff it needs in its set (neblla_update_app business.booking).

user.description: The user id in the app (userBookings, userNotes, userNote)

name: neblla_business
